entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Adventure Path #119: Prisoner of the Blight
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your confidence in exploring dangerous regions inspires the same in your companions.

Prerequisite(s): Blight Survivalist, Skill Focus (Survival).

Benefit(s): Your bonus on saving throws gained from the Blight Survivalist feat extends to your allies within 30 feet. Furthermore, once per day, if you would fail a saving throw against an environmental hazard or weather effect, you can reroll that save, but you must use the second result, even if it is lower.
